_persist._description: Redux Persist metadata for rehydration state.

agentWorkspace._description: Controls the agent workspace UI layout, sidebar, VNC dialog, computer position, and chat search.

aiCanvas._description: Stores all AI canvas instances and OCR cache data.

aiCanvasEditor._description: Full state for the AI canvas editor: shapes, camera, tools, brushing, marking, context menu, screenshots, text editing, settings, comments.

api._description: RTK Query API slice. Contains cached query/mutation results, subscriptions, cache invalidation tags, and config. This is the ONLY RTK Query slice in the entire store.

queries.type: object (dynamic map keyed by endpointName + serialized args)

subscriptions.type: object (dynamic map keyed by endpointName + serialized args)
subscriptions._description: Maps each active query to its subscriber IDs and their polling config.

auth._description: User authentication, profile info, usage/credits, global settings, client config, region, invitation codes.

biz._description: Business/billing data: credit packages, plan tiers (personal and team), trials, SSO/SCIM subscriptions, auto top-up.

chat._description: Chat input state, file attachments, slide templates, image styles, playbooks, editor content, data visualization, debug overrides.

codeViewer._description: Code viewer/editor state: directory tree, file tabs, file data, active tab.

directoryMetaData.type: object (dynamic map keyed by directory path)

community._description: Community/explore page data source and grouping.

configs._description: User-level client configuration and preferences persisted locally.

connectors._description: Installed/available connectors (integrations), GitHub repos, temporary overrides, search, email/calendar confirmation.

brief.example: Access the web on your own browser

enterpriseTeam._description: Enterprise team management: API keys and audit logs.

example._description: Example/template prompts list for the homepage.

experiment._description: A/B experiment feature flags. Frontend variants (from SDK) and backend variants (from server).

variants.type: object (dynamic map keyed by experiment name)

backendVariants.type: object (dynamic map keyed by experiment name)

fileConnector._description: File storage connectors (Google Drive, OneDrive, Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Figma, Outlook).

fileManagement._description: File management panel: spaces, session file list, download mode, Google Drive picker, space editing.

filePreviewer._description: File previewer/editor state: preview data, save status, file history, sharing, fullscreen, slides.

knowledge._description: User knowledge base: list, loading state, suggested knowledge map.

library._description: Attachment library: filters, lists, groups, favorites, search, view type.

login._description: Login/registration flow state: email, password, captcha, verification code, team/edu invitations.

mailManus._description: Manus agent email configuration: agent email info, whitelist, sub-emails, unread status.

navbar._description: Navigation bar state: active tab, hover, minimal mode.

notification._description: Notification system: connection status, categorized notifications, update page, read/unread state.

content.example: Turn your AI into any expert you need...

project._description: Project management: list, current project, loading states.

sessions._description: Core session management: current session, session list (normalized entity adapter), grouped sessions, collaborators, segments, sharing.

title.example: Is Manus.im Using a Framework or Library for UI?

swapSessionDetailMap.type: object (dynamic map keyed by session uid)

slideEditor._description: Slide editor state for presentation editing.

team._description: Team management: team list, members, renewal settings, SSO/SCIM, access controls, asset sharing, enterprise banner.

timeline._description: Timeline/replay state: segment events map, loading map, playback percentage.

segmentEventsMap.type: object (dynamic map keyed by segment ID)

segmentEventsLoadingMap.type: object (dynamic map keyed by segment ID)

ui._description: Global UI state: responsive layout, sidebar dimensions, window width, feature introductions.

webDev._description: Web development workspace: project, preview, database, settings, storage, webview, mobile publishing, git sync, iOS publishing, code editor tabs.

webdevAuth._description: Web development authentication state. Currently empty.

websocket._description: WebSocket connection and real-time event stream. Uses RTK EntityAdapter for normalized event storage. Contains all chat messages, tool calls, status updates, plan steps, etc.

entities.type: object (RTK EntityAdapter normalized map keyed by event ID)
entities._description: Each entity wraps a real-time event from the WebSocket stream.

event._description: The actual event payload. Structure varies by event type.
